doc: Schema and field descriptions for each table.

aspects.doc: All the known playable races in deepwoken.

innate.doc: Innate stat points the aspect grants your character.

is_pathfinder.doc: If the race is obtainable in Pathfinder.

colors.doc: The variant's eye, hair, skin, tone and sclera colors. Also includes feature, marking, design and under colors where present.

unlock.doc: How to unlock the variant, if there's a condition.

exclude_cosmetics.doc: Face cosmetics the aspect can't wear.

books.doc: All the known readable books in deepwoken.

enchants.doc: All the known weapon and equipment enchants in deepwoken.

category.doc: If the enchant goes on weapons or on equipment.

effects.doc: Values the enchant sets other than stats, such as effect duration. Each value is a number or formula.

obtainable_in.doc: Which gamemode the enchant drops in (Pathfinder or VOI).

stats.doc: The stats the enchant grants (a number or a formula).

equipment.doc: All the known equipment in deepwoken.

equippable.doc: Whether the item can be equipped.

percentage.doc: If the value is a percentage instead of a flat amount.

pips.doc: How many pip slots the piece has, per pip rarity.

prereqs.doc: Prerequisites as table:key references. Every entry is required. Use | within an entry for alternatives.

reqs.doc: Stat requirements to equip it. Use () if there are none.

set.doc: The equipment set it belongs to, if any.

talents.doc: Talents the piece grants while worn.

variants.doc: Cosmetic variant names. Each name must match a modifier folder in the assets repo, or the variant renders with the base appearance.

voi.doc: If it's obtainable in Vow of Iron.

voi_only.doc: If it's only obtainable in Vow of Iron.

wiki.doc: Extra notes on how to obtain it.

items.doc: Misc items in deepwoken (brewing ingredients, mantra gems, modifiers, sparks and salts).

kind.doc: What kind of item it is.

asset.doc: The item's model key in the assets repo (used for its thumbnail).

brewing.doc: The item's brewing values per potion effect, if known.

effect.doc: What the item does when used.

icon.doc: The icon's filename, without the extension.

voi.doc: If it's obtainable in Vow of Iron.

voi_only.doc: If it's only obtainable in Vow of Iron.

mantras.doc: All the known mantras in deepwoken.

attributes.doc: The mantra's stat or attunement tags. For oath, origin, monster and event mantras, put the source tag first (e.g. Oath: Saintsworn). Use an existing tag or add a new one.

category.doc: The slot category the mantra takes up.

ether_cost.doc: The ether cost per cast, if known.

reqs.doc: Stat requirements to obtain it. Use () if there are none.

type.doc: The mantra's source. Normal mantras roll from attunements. Other mantras come from oaths, origins, monsters or events.

vaulted.doc: If the mantra is currently vaulted (removed from the game).

voi.doc: If it's obtainable in Vow of Iron.

effects.doc: Values the mantra sets other than stats, such as effect duration. Each value is a number or formula.

flat_level_5_cost.doc: The flat ether cost at level 5.

icon.doc: The icon's filename, without the extension.

miscellaneous.doc: Any extra notes on the mantra.

modifiers.doc: Modifier items that can be applied to the mantra.

prereqs.doc: Prerequisites as table:key references. Every entry is required. Use | within an entry for alternatives.

related_talents.doc: Talents that interact with the mantra.

scaling.doc: The mantra's damage scaling per stat.

shared_cooldowns.doc: Mantras that share a cooldown with this one.

sparks.doc: Sparks that can be applied to the mantra.

stats.doc: The stats the mantra grants while equipped (a number or a formula).

voi_only.doc: If it's only obtainable in Vow of Iron.

wiki.doc: Extra notes on how to obtain it.

objectives.doc: Known quests, rites and mementos in Deepwoken that can be used as prerequisites.

accountWideUnlock.doc: If completing it once unlocks it for all your characters.

prereqs.doc: Prerequisites as table:key references. Every entry is required. Use | within an entry for alternatives.

reqs.doc: The stat requirements to do it, if any.

origins.doc: All the known origins in deepwoken.

faction.doc: The faction you start in, if any.

outfits.doc: All the known outfits in deepwoken.

extra_percents.doc: Extra percentage bonuses the outfit gives (e.g. Ether Regen, Extra Stealth).

mats.doc: The materials needed to craft it.

reqs.doc: Stat requirements to equip it. Use () if there are none.

talent.doc: The talent the outfit grants while worn, if any.

voi.doc: If it's obtainable in Vow of Iron.

voi_only.doc: If it's only obtainable in Vow of Iron.

prereqs.doc: Prerequisites as table:key references. Every entry is required. Use | within an entry for alternatives.

variants.doc: Cosmetic variant names. Each name must match a modifier folder in the assets repo, or the variant renders with the base appearance.

pips.doc: The stats equipment pips can roll.

amounts.doc: The roll amount per equipment slot, stat and pip rarity.

potion_effects.doc: All the potion effects in deepwoken. Each ingredient contributes to these when brewing.

formula.doc: The formula that turns the effect's total into its strength.

negative_suffixes.doc: Potion name suffixes for the negative effect, by strength.

positive_suffixes.doc: Potion name suffixes for the positive effect, by strength.

timed.doc: If the effect lasts for a duration instead of being instant.

unit.doc: What the computed value means (a multiplier, a percent, per second, a flat amount or seconds).

negative.doc: The name of the negative effect.

positive.doc: The name of the positive effect.

obtain_if_available.doc: Entries the solver obtains if the build can already reach them, written as table:key references.

opts.doc: The reqfile script the preset applies.

resonances.doc: All the known resonances (bells) in deepwoken.

talents.doc: All the known talents in deepwoken.

count_towards_talent_total.doc: If the talent counts towards your talent total.

rarity.doc: The talent's rarity. Values such as Oath and Equipment mean the talent is granted by that source instead of rolled.

reqs.doc: Stat requirements to obtain it. Use () if there are none.

roll2able.doc: If the talent can show up in rolls.

vaulted.doc: If the talent is currently vaulted (removed from the game).

voi.doc: If it's obtainable in Vow of Iron.

additional_info.doc: Extra info shown under the description.

effects.doc: Values the talent sets other than stats, such as effect duration. Each value is a number or formula.

exclusive.doc: Talents you can't have at the same time as this one.

icon.doc: The icon's filename, without the extension.

immediate_grants.doc: Talents granted automatically when you take this one. Their own requirements and exclusivity are ignored, and they unlock whenever this talent does.

implicit.doc: If it's an attunement milestone you get automatically from stats instead of picking it.

multiplicative_percents.doc: Multiplicative percentage stat bonuses (a number or a formula).

prereqs.doc: Prerequisites as table:key references. Every entry is required. Use | within an entry for alternatives.

stats.doc: The stats the talent grants (a number or a formula).

voi_only.doc: If it's only obtainable in Vow of Iron.

variables.doc: Toggles and sliders that formulas in stats fields can reference.

id.doc: The ID used in formulas, in SCREAMING_SNAKE case. The filename is the same ID in lowercase.

default.doc: The default value (a bool for toggles, a number for sliders).

kind.doc: If it's a toggle or a slider.

weapons.doc: All the known weapons in deepwoken.

enchantable.doc: If the weapon can be enchanted.

equip_motifs.doc: If the weapon can equip motifs.

reqs.doc: Stat requirements to equip it. Use () if there are none.

type.doc: The weapon type. Combined types such as Spear / Rifle count as both.

voi.doc: If it's obtainable in Vow of Iron.

attack_duration.doc: How long a swing takes, in seconds.

can_offhand.doc: If the weapon can go in your offhand.

chip_damage.doc: The fraction of damage that goes through a block.

endlag.doc: The endlag after a swing in seconds, if known.

only_offhand.doc: If the weapon can only go in your offhand.

penetration.doc: The fraction of armor the weapon ignores.

posture_max.doc: The posture bonus while holding it.

prereqs.doc: Prerequisites as table:key references. Every entry is required. Use | within an entry for alternatives.

range_type.doc: If the attack lunges forward or sweeps.

scaling.doc: The weapon's damage scaling per stat.

talents.doc: Talents the weapon grants while held.

voi_only.doc: If it's only obtainable in Vow of Iron.
